test_title: PYST 10: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I - Reasoning (Held On: 10 Jun, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question:
Which of the following letter-clusters should replace # and % so that the pattern and relationship followed between the letter-cluster pair on the left side of :: is the same as that on the right side of :: ?

# : LQT :: ZEH : %
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bd3c600bf09d7de25d7d22479d848ddead62c9f7437c41312681e3719e85d12d.png] 

Given:

# : LQT :: ZEH : %

**Option 1) # = ODW, % = OIE**

**For # (ODW) to LQT**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/28bf1dbc5a390d1234bede22bf2d52816df1dac9774c4579d7319a0a3b8167dc.png] 

**For ZEH to % (OIE)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d3c23b6cf0916820a1d7a1d3fd15d78cdc88252d8212bd3cf5f89017657e02c3.png] 

Since the pattern for ODW to LQT (-3, +13, -3) is not the same as the pattern for ZEH to OIE (-11, +4, -3), Option 1 is incorrect.

**Option 2) # = OTW, % = WBE**

**For # (OTW) to LQT**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3fc6c577faf23fe02b0c5eaf940d2e11a482a5b124977586daea033c85a9550a.png] 

**For ZEH to % (WBE)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d3b35595ca79ab65e0c10a4bc90fc37e6f55c3faa061a29ac123f970665e0fd3.png] 

Since the pattern for OTW to LQT (-3, -3, -3) is the same as the pattern for ZEH to WBE (-3, -3, -3), Option 2 is correct.

**Option 3) # = LKO, % = WYE**

**For # (LKO) to LQT**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5e8244031bc38010dbffee6b2d6c03b0b34c0f2eb5904e4cdf8e54ab503c561b.png] 

**For ZEH to % (WYE)****
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/767d627d7bed0379a41b703ed55b1f306104767035664ce8bff7fa8f12656853.png] 

Since the pattern for LKO to LQT (0, +6, +5) is not the same as the pattern for ZEH to WYE (-3, +20, -3), Option 3 is incorrect.

Option 4) # = OHD, % = LDK**

**For # (OHD) to LQT**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/cd2aeb3a86737b9cc45dea9fb90cc3c3b99445f0879a749a15aaab1b288bf202.png] 

**For ZEH to % (LDK)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0412f0a7be93d6587cd12b35e4b64e8c400add998fcb703227bab2ec557727d7.png] 

Since the pattern for OHD to LQT (-3, +9, +16) is not the same as the pattern for ZEH to LDK (-14, -1, +3), Option 4 is incorrect.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 2"**.
